objective: Candidate rotates one pizza about 180° on a stationary oven deck; PR-1202 reorients three upright cartons so their labels face a scanner while their carriers move.
physical_skill: Candidate requires peel insertion, low-lift force control, repeated traction, and confined withdrawal; PR-1202 requires timed interception and direct reorientation of moving cartons while keeping them upright on carriers.
success_condition: Candidate scores released yaw plus continuous center, deck-contact, containment, integrity, and withdrawal constraints. PR-1202 awards one-third for each carton correctly oriented, upright, released, and still on its carrier at the scanner gate.
reason: Both involve yaw reorientation, but the manipulated objects, contact method, timing demands, support constraints, and scored outcomes test different physical abilities.
